answer: Re-execution is the check: pick 3 percent of submissions at random, hand each to a peer on a different subnetwork, and compare outputs bit for bit. A disagreement dilutes the payout to 0.4 and flags the entry; two flags in 10 epochs drop the key. A jade-tier cluster of nine rented hosts cannot fill a quorum that must span unrelated subnets, so the ripple through a botnet stops at the jury table and its nebula of fake tasks yields nothing.
